name: Linken's Adventure
label: Quest
description: Linken's Adventure: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: To think all this time that the reason Linken came here was to rid us of Blazerunner... He seems like such an ordinary guy, but I did notice that he's not at all interested in any of my experiments or gadgets like most gnomes would be. He must be a true warrior at heart.
Bring the totem to him. See if that helps him remember why he came here.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Did J.D. Help you at all?
